adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 312-315 in the diff for deleteEvent: `const calendarId = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the code enters the else branch and tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (which is undefined/null). This comparison will never match any calendar, so the find returns undefined, and calendarId becomes undefined. Then at line 318, it uses `calendarId || defaultCalendarId` which falls back to 'primary'. This is indeed a bug - the logic is broken because when externalCalendarId is not provided, the find condition uses the same undefined value, making the search meaningless. The same bug exists in updateEvent at line 253-255.
